context.title: SF YIMBY — November 3, 2026 California general election endorsements

subject.title: Governor of California

positions.statement: We support Xavier Becerra because of the commitment he made when he filled out our questionnaire: "I will pursue legislation to ensure state housing law applies in the coastal zone just like everywhere else."

subject.title: Attorney General of California

positions.statement: YIMBY Action endorses Rob Bonta for Attorney General because he has been one of the strongest enforcers of California's housing laws.

subject.title: California — Proposition 1 (Authorizes Bonds for Housing Affordability Programs)

positions.statement: Prop 1: Bond For Affordable Housing - ballot measure · California · Vote yes

subject.title: California — Proposition 37 (Creates Loan Program for Middle-Income Buyers of Qualified New Homes)

positions.statement: Prop 37: Downpayment assistance for new homes · California · Vote yes

subject.title: California — Proposition 43 (Limits Voters' Ability to Raise Revenues for Local Government Services)

positions.statement: Prop 43: Supermajority vote for tax initatives · California · Vote no

subject.title: US House of Representatives, California District 11

positions.statement: Scott Wiener is a housing champion who has literally been the spark for a nationwide movement of legislators leading on the issue

subject.title: California State Assembly, District 17

positions.statement: Matt Haney · Assemblymember District 17 · California Assembly District 17 · Endorsed

subject.title: California State Assembly, District 19

positions.statement: Catherine Stefani · Assemblymember District 19 · California Assembly District 19 · Endorsed

subject.title: San Francisco Board of Supervisors, District 2

positions.statement: Stephen Sherrill · County Board District 2 · San Francisco Board of Supervisors District 2 · Endorsed

subject.title: San Francisco Board of Supervisors, District 4

positions.statement: Alan Wong · County Board District 4 · San Francisco Board of Supervisors District 4 · Endorsed

subject.title: San Francisco Board of Supervisors, District 6

positions.statement: SF YIMBY endorses Matt Dorsey to continue to champion the housing legislations and reforms that the city needs.

subject.title: San Francisco Board of Supervisors, District 8

positions.statement: SF YIMBY is endorsing Gary McCoy in the top slot due to his history of commitment to YIMBYism and his strong potential as a member of the board of supervisors.

subject.title: San Francisco Board of Supervisors, District 10

positions.statement: SF YIMBY endorses Theo Ellington for District 10 supervisor.

subject.title: San Francisco Assessor-Recorder

positions.statement: Joaquin Torres is running unopposed for another term as Assessor-Recorder, and SF YIMBY is happy to endorse him again.

subject.title: BART Board of Directors, District 8

positions.statement: SF YIMBY is proud to endorse Sara Barz for Bart Board District 8.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition A (Charter Changes Affecting Various City Departments and Commissions)

positions.statement: SF YIMBY endorses Proposition A because it gives the Board the flexibility to make those updates instead of requiring yet another ballot measure.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition C (Contributions to the Housing Fund)

positions.statement: SF YIMBY is proud to endorse the single most consequential affordable housing-supply fix on this November’s ballot.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition D (Changes to Ballot Measure Process)

positions.statement: Shorter ballots, more accountable lawmaking.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition E (City Administrator's Authority and Changes to City Contracting)

positions.statement: Housing supply doesn't happen in a vacuum — it needs functioning city infrastructure processes around it, and Prop E is a real fix.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition F (Changes to Executive Branch Management)

positions.statement: SF YIMBY endorses a vote of YES to fix a long-broken system that worsens our housing shortage.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition G (Allowing Private Vehicles on the Great Highway in Sunset Dunes Park)

positions.statement: SF YIMBY is proud to continue to support this park and endorses voting NO to closing the park and bringing back the highway.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition H (Parcel Tax to Fund Public Muni Operations)

positions.statement: Transit and housing supply are the same fight. Every unit of housing in this city only works if people can actually get around. SF YIMBY is proud to support this measure.

subject.title: San Francisco — Proposition I (Changes to Real Property Transfer Tax)

positions.statement: Taxing housing in order to build housing is self-defeating.

subject.title: Bay Area — Regional Measure RTM (Regional Transit Measure)

positions.statement: A regional economy this large cannot function with a gutted BART, and a modest, sunsetting sales tax is a far better outcome than losing the system.
